datasets.title: Hourly Anomaly Scores and Leak Labels from a Multi-Source Urban Water Distribution Network Dataset
datasets.citation: Jan, Babela; Munk, Michal; Munkova, Dasa; https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15096167
intended_uses: descriptive association and threshold-screen comparisons of published anomaly scores against the publisher's leak-proximity label
limitations: The CSV contains already-derived anomaly scores, not raw process channels or mechanistic validation.
Scores are dimensionless standardized indices, not physical sensor values; do not label them as measured pressure, flow, vibration or temperature.
The binary label indicates a recorded leak within a plus/minus seven-day window, not the event instant; event lead time and causal direction cannot be recovered from this label alone.
Rows near the same leak window are temporally dependent. Use chronological blocks with an explicit purge and seek original event identities before claiming independent evaluation.
The released feature set was selected using association with the leak label; score-label metrics are descriptive and do not independently validate the upstream scoring algorithms.
A zero label means no leak was recorded within the label rule, not proof of leak-free operation; one anonymized zone and one year do not establish transferability.
Raw CSV and row-level derived records remain outside the source-code release.
datasets.split_unit: chronological blocks with a documented purge at least as wide as the label window; original leak episodes are not separately identified
